title: Creative Delivery Variant
description: One equivalent trafficking representation retained before seller binding. `variant_id` is stable within its CreativeSource and identifies source representation, not rotation, A/B content, build output, locale, or a seller's served execution variant.

variant_id.description: Stable source-representation identifier, unique within the enclosing CreativeSource.

source_id.description: Optional immutable source-system identifier for this representation.
